g.text: Ideal op-amp, stable negative feedback, linear unsaturated operation, zero input currents. Difference-amplifier resistor ratios must match to cancel common-mode

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: voltage; arbitrary four resistor values give a different expression. Signals are referenced to the ground symbols. Real accuracy depends on resistor ratios, bias
